column1: # The namespace wall's rename table (intermediary -> mojang names, C/M/F rows) by the release a
# conversion TARGETS. Every reader picks its table here and nowhere else: Main.convert (the whole-jar
# rename, the target hierarchy, the audit), build.sh's gates, step_check / probe_segments /
# A table spells every class and member the way its target release declares it, so one table per
# naming era: Mojang moved and renamed classes between 26.1 and 26.2 (advancements/criterion ->
# predicates + triggers, GuiGraphics stayed GuiGraphicsExtractor ...). The climb crosses the wall at
# its 1.21.11 -> 26.1 step, so its table is 26.1's, and the 26.1.2 -> 26.2 step moves the classes
# Generate a table with core/tools/wall_table.py (see its header). A table is a file name under
# <data>/mappings, or a path (absolute, or relative to the working directory).
